_about: THE NEW STANDARD (docs/dev/SCENE_ENGINE.md section 15, user decision 7 Oct 2026): `bar` is what every scene must reach: the rich Yateley and Fleet scenes (depth layers, dense ground cover, life at every depth, a signature, the live sky, seasons, shadows, reflections and night lights) at a frame budget. The composed profile measures it (scene lint), and new scenes are COMPOSED from the object library (scene new, scene upgrade). `scenes` and `items` are the earlier gold set, now the LEGACY exemplars: hand-drawn craft to learn from, below the new bar. `weaker` lists accepted scenes that fall short: do better than them. `node tools/anim-pack.mjs reference` prints it; `reference --render` writes the PNGs to .anim-ref/.

bar.why: THE BAR for open country. Depth: a hazy far tree line, a mid band of birch and pine, near heath and a framing foreground, each in its own layer with haze between them. Cover: heather, gorse and grass carpet the whole lower ground, no bare columns. Life: walkers with a dog, rabbits, butterflies, bees, birds crossing and swaying plants at three depths. Light: the live sky of the real sun, shadows along it, the season by date.
The same heath at evening: match the low warm light, the long shadows and the way the far layers fade into the glow while the near cover stays crisp.
Winter done right: bare twig lattices, frost and russet cover instead of summer green, a still pool reflecting the trees, and life that still moves (water birds, a walker) under a low winter sun.
Spring and a mixed setting: a village green with houses, a pond and wild flowers. Match the density of the meadow cover, the blossom, and the windows that light at real dusk.

THE BAR for water: a wide lake with reflections of everything at its edge, reed beds along the margins, swans, ducks and dragonflies on and over the water, walkers on the shore, shimmer and the glitter road of the real sun.
Autumn: copper and gold crowns, falling leaves, reeds gone tawny; the same depth, cover and life as summer in the colours of the season.

_use: Before drawing: render the exemplars nearest your subject (skyline, mountains, monument, water, desert, snow, tropics, night lights, wildlife) and read their source (the 'source' field).

After drawing: `node tools/anim-pack.mjs sheet <your refs> --contact` (light) and `--mode night`, then hold your render next to the exemplar: same depth layers, same finish, same life. Passing the lint is the floor; this comparison is the bar.

Study technique, not content: ask what each exemplar does that makes it look finished (layers, haze between them, a reflection, framing foreground, motion at three depths, a lit evening grade) and do the same for your subject.

For a NEW scene: render the bar (reference --render) and match it: compose from the library and check with scene lint --perf and scene sheet --times --seasons. The convert stage replaces the bar entries by their composed versions (kind: composed) and adds the pilot upgrades.

scenes.why: Three depth layers of towers (a hazy far row, a mid row with the Empire State, Chrysler and One WTC as hand-built path silhouettes with rows of window dots) sit behind a Brooklyn Bridge whose cables are computed catenary curves, over reflected water with shimmer, moving boats and flickering aircraft lights, all in one violet-pink-amber dusk palette.

One shared silhouette path is drawn three times (shadow side, lit face, snow caps), a haze band sits in front of it, and the same peaks are flipped into the lake at half opacity as a reflection, while golden aspens with white trunks frame both sides and leaves fall (usfall).

The prang is built by a loop of tapered tiers, each with a shaded half, a dashed tile line and edge strokes, then repeated at two smaller scales for depth; a river reflection, two long-tail boats at different scales and palms in a faster parallax layer frame it at sunrise.

Suspension cables are quadratic curves with dozens of computed hangers, the towers carry cross-braces and an aircraft light, a car and a freighter cross at different speeds, and a parallax pine ridge plus a darker static pine foreground close the frame against a pale sunrise water gradient.

Stepped buttes are generated by a loop and filled with banded strata gradients that darken in three parallax layers with haze between them, a river with glints runs through the middle, and swaying saguaros and a dark rock foreground give the scale cue.

Two aurora curtains are wavy gradient paths with vertical ray strokes that sway and drift at different speeds over twinkling stars, with a snowy range, a lit cabin town, a bobbing moose silhouette and swaying firs in dark foreground silhouette.

Overwater villas run along a jetty in true perspective (the same villa scaled from 1.46 down to 0.42), over a turquoise lagoon gradient with lighter shallows and ripples, a sunburst and a seaplane gliding across, framed by palms.

Everything that should glow is on the evening classes (window-dot grids on the three towers, the supertree rings and bulbs on us-lamps / us-lit), so the dark and night themes switch the whole bay on, while the daytime paint stays a clean violet-pink dusk with a mirrored reflection, a spinning observation wheel and a lit ferry.

The loon is a patterned subject (white spotted back, red eye, black head) reflected in still water, set against layered spruce silhouettes veiled by three haze bands, so a single animal and a quiet palette carry the whole picture.

A dense, readable beach: towers with window grids, a pier with piles and a lifeguard house, dolphins breaking the surface, striped umbrellas, a kite and sailboat, and more than a hundred moving groups at many speeds (birds, waves, shimmer) without ever hiding the subject.

items.why: A silhouette that reads at 28 px: stacked decks, two stacks with x-steam puffs, a wheel on x-spin and two staggered x-wave lines (different --d) over a water band, every colour a theme class (k c s w m, lk lc lm lw).

Wildlife with life in 64 units: a patterned shell, two flippers on x-flap with a 0.6 s offset, a bobbing body, three bubbles on x-rise at 1 s steps, and wave lines framing the top and bottom of the tile.

A loop builds seven tapering tiers that alternate c and s fills with lk eave strokes so the stack reads as a pagoda at any size, plus a glowing moon, a twinkling star, river waves and rising smoke: four independent motions on a still building.

Five lanterns are each their own x-swing group with the same duration and a different --d, each with a glowing core, hung from a curved thick rope with twinkling sparkles: staggering one motion class makes a festival.

A whole landscape in 64 units by fills alone: a tinted sky plate, a snow-capped mountain, a hill band, trees on x-tree, translucent water with three waves, a bobbing ferry with twinkling windows and two gulls on x-flap; depth comes from s / m / c fills and opacity only.
Each lamp is an x-bob group holding an x-flicker flame with its own --d, so one object carries two motions without a transform attribute, in front of a ghat skyline and a wave line.

weaker.wrong: Five identical camel silhouettes stand in a straight row (cloned shapes at one scale), the rock arch is one fat blob with a few parallel stripes, the clouds are flat ellipses, and the middle distance is empty.
weaker.fix: Vary the animals (pose, size, spacing along a perspective line), build the rock from banded strata with a shadow side, and fill the middle distance with layers and life.

weaker.wrong: A flat purple mountain over a plain dark strip with a few spikes: the glowing star is the only detail, there is almost no foreground or atmosphere, and little moves.
weaker.fix: Give the ground texture and layers, add haze between depth planes, and put life at several depths so the star is a focal point rather than the whole picture.

weaker.wrong: Pale blob dunes with almost no tonal contrast, two stick plants and a few streaks: nothing leads the eye and the shapes are soft and unformed.
weaker.fix: Carve dune crests with a light side and a shadow side, add ripples and a foreground plant with weight, and create a tonal range from deep shadow to bright sand.

weaker.wrong: The crags are a single beige slab with parallel stripes in muddy olive and grey, a lone grey disc, and the UK template sky and hills: no readable rock forms.
weaker.fix: Draw the gritstone as stepped blocks with cracks and a lit face, add heather and a path to lead in, and make the sky and light belong to the scene.

weaker.wrong: White arcade and domes on white: a tonal range of only 0.82, no shadow side or depth layers, so the mosque reads as a flat cut-out against pale water.
weaker.fix: Shade the domes and arches, add a darker foreground and a lit horizon, and break the white mass with colour, reflections and layers.

weaker.wrong: Five identical white tents stamped in a row, ant-like figures in grey dots, and a flat green field under the same template sky, sun and clouds as 160 other UK scenes.
weaker.fix: Draw each tent differently (size, colour, perspective), add a recognisable subject and real foreground, and give the scene its own sky and palette.

weakerItems.wrong: A sap bucket that does not read at 28 px: two gold discs float over a grey tap and a small glass, nothing joins them into one object, there is no dominant mass and one motion group only.
weakerItems.fix: Draw ONE object (the bucket hanging on its tree trunk, a drop falling into it) as a single dominant mass on a ground line, with the supporting details around it and three staggered motions (drip, swing, shimmer).

weakerItems.wrong: A flat amber oval with a few dark specks and a white label strip: a blob with no form (no shadow side, no skin texture, nothing that says potato rather than bread), steam wisps as the only motion.
weakerItems.fix: Give the object a silhouette and a tone hierarchy (lit side `c`, shadow side `s`, skin marks in `k`), put it in a context that identifies it (a furrow, a basket, a split baked potato with steam), and move more than the steam.

weakerItems.wrong: The bloom is a pink disc with a ring in the middle on a thin stem: it reads as a lollipop, not a rose (no overlapping petals, no cup, no calyx), and the leaves are two grey slivers.
weakerItems.fix: Build the bloom from overlapping petal shapes of two tones with a visible spiral centre, add a calyx and real leaves, and let the bloom sway while a petal drifts.

weakerItems.wrong: A pale lilac kite on a pale lilac tile: the upper half of the diamond is near-white on near-white and vanishes at 28 px, the tail is a short grey squiggle, and the ground is an empty flat grey slab.
weakerItems.fix: Use the hero colour at full strength for the whole kite body with an `s` / `k` contrast plane and cross-spars, a tail with bows, and a ground line with something on it; keep three motions (sway, tail ripple, a drifting cloud).
